title: Export a single invoice / payment acknowledgement as PDF
description: Wardens want to hand (or WhatsApp) a tenant a proper receipt-style PDF for a specific invoice or payment, distinct from LODGY-23's whole-month CSV/PDF report export. This is a per-transaction acknowledgement a tenant can keep. Depends on LODGY-56 (shared PDF rendering foundation) - build against that renderer rather than starting a second, independent PDF pipeline; LODGY-45's full-data export needs the same foundation and the two should not diverge.
acceptanceCriteria: From an invoice or a recorded payment, warden can export a PDF acknowledgement showing tenant name, room, period, amount, payment mode, and date
PDF is saved via SAF to a location the warden picks, same pattern as LODGY-23/LODGY-28
Numbers on the PDF match the underlying invoice/payment records exactly

history.note: Added from the v2 feedback session (warden interviews after the v1 field test) and from buried enhancement/limitation notes surfaced while re-reading the full v1 board history.

Added an explicit dependency on LODGY-56 - this ticket and LODGY-45 both need PDF rendering and were at risk of building two separate, inconsistent pipelines. LODGY-56 builds the shared renderer first; this ticket and LODGY-45 consume it.
Starting - a per-invoice acknowledgement built on LODGY-56's renderer and saved through the same SAF CreateDocument flow LODGY-23 uses.

Per-invoice acknowledgement built on LODGY-56's renderer, no second PDF pipeline. pdf/InvoiceAcknowledgement.kt assembles the PdfDocumentContent - hostel as subtitle, tenant/room+bed/period, invoice amount, credit line when there is one, amount due, total paid, balance, then a Date/Mode/Amount table of every recorded payment (or a plain sentence when there are none, rather than an empty table) and the issue date. All chrome comes in through an AcknowledgementLabels object the composable fills from string resources, so the receipt prints in whichever language the warden is running, and every number arrives pre-formatted from the invoice/payment/credit rows - nothing is recomputed in the builder, so the sheet a tenant is handed cannot drift from what the app shows (AC 3). AcknowledgementViewModel walks invoice -> agreement -> tenant and agreement -> bed -> room -> floor -> hostel, sorts payments oldest-first, and runs the credit through the same effectiveAmountDue() as everywhere else; an overpayment reads as a zero balance rather than a negative one, and a deleted invoice says so instead of rendering blanks. Reached from a Receipt button on every invoice row (paid ones included - a receipt for a settled invoice is the common case), and saved through the same SAF ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument flow as LODGY-23/28, with mime application/pdf and a lodgy-receipt-<month>-<year>.pdf default name. Tests: InvoiceAcknowledgementTest for structure, the payments table, the no-payments and no-credit cases, and that a 200-payment receipt paginates without losing a row; AcknowledgementViewModelTest for the data gathering, ordering, credit maths, overpayment and missing-invoice cases. testDebugUnitTest green.
